'''Bako''' was a game played by the [[Bossban]] [[Soergg Vosadii Bezhin|Soergg]]'s [[Concubine/Legends|concubines]] at his [[Soergg Vosadii Bezhin's headquarters|headquarters]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ansion/Legends|Ansion]]<ref name="AS">''[[The Approaching Storm]]''</ref> in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[The Approaching Storm]]'' to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].</ref>
